business_context.client_da_note: 0 at Phase 0; the orchestrator copies metrics.json client_domain_authority into config.client_da at Phase 5 Step 5.1
business_context.jurisdiction: Melbourne, Victoria, Australia (VIC). Single-city service area — Melbourne CBD + 14 client-named inner suburbs. No interstate targeting.
business_context.terminology_note: AU English throughout — 'caterers' not 'catering companies' is the higher-volume head form (2,900/mo vs 480/mo). 'Canape' searched without the accent. 'Morning tea' / 'afternoon tea' are AU-specific workplace-catering terms with no US equivalent.
business_context.allocation_basis_statement: Allocation derived from N1=150 GSC queries (90d) + N2=40 GSC top pages + N3=15 sitemap pages + N4=12 nav categories + N5=50 existing tracked keywords. Tier weights reflect the demand signal across these sources, filtered to demand NOT already covered by the existing 50.
source_gaps_flagged: N5 was NOT retrievable via mcp__plugin_kwr_seranking__PROJECT_* — that namespace registered DATA_* only because the SER MCP child booted before /kwr:init wrote KWR_DATA_ONLY=0. Per run/SKILL.md line 144 this is recorded as a flagged gap, not a silent skip. The universe was captured out-of-band at analyst level and is COMPLETE (50/50, reconciles with config.seranking_keyword_count). See raw/seranking-existing-keywords.json.
GSC query pull capped at rowLimit=150 by clicks — this is not the full query set. Phase 1's GSC seed source mines deeper (impressions >= 10).
DataForSEO returned volume for 10 of 20 probed keywords in batch 1 and 7 of 16 in batch 2. Absent keywords are below DFS reporting threshold — treated as unmeasured, NOT as zero demand.

competitive_landscape.seed_source: Brave Search live SERP for 'catering Melbourne' during preflight; analyst-approved. Guaranteed into Phase 3b regardless of auto-discovery ranking.
competitive_landscape.vertical_note: Melbourne catering SERPs are directory- and listicle-heavy. Auto-discovery alone risks surfacing content platforms above genuine caterers, which is why real competitors were seeded.

critical_structural_finding.headline: This client has a RANKING problem, not a coverage problem.
critical_structural_finding.evidence: Homepage takes 174,106 impressions at position 15.2 while the commercial service pages sit at 20-53: /corporate-catering/ pos 52.6 (10,912 impr, 14 clicks), /event-catering/ pos 46.3 (8,362 impr), /corporate-catering/cocktail-party/ pos 28.8 (14,279 impr), /corporate-catering/drop-off/ pos 39.9, /corporate-catering/conference-meeting/ pos 49.2. Informational blog posts outrank all of them at positions 5.9-11.1.
critical_structural_finding.consequence_for_this_package: The existing 50 keywords point at those weak pages. Adding 20 more aimed at the same silos would repeat the pattern. This allocation therefore favours demand where GSC already proves position 4-15 traction, and service lines with no page at all (where a purpose-built page can be created rather than inheriting a position-50 one).
critical_structural_finding.out_of_scope_but_report_to_client: Fixing the corporate/event page rankings is the single highest-value action for this site and is NOT part of a keyword package. Flag at the Phase 5 checkpoint.

tracks.post_phase1_amendment: Was 8/5/7/0 at the Phase 0 checkpoint. Phase 1 identified 'melbourne catering company' (existing_page_optimisation) as a word-order+plural duplicate of tracked 'Catering Companies Melbourne'. It was replaced by 'wedding caterers melbourne', which qualifies as quick_wins on GSC evidence (pos 3.75, 915 impr) — hence 9/4/7/0. Tier budgets are unchanged at 10/6/4.
tracks.split_rationale: Plugin default for upgrade clients is 30/30/30/10. Two deviations, both deliberate: (1) geo_expansion = 0 because the client is single-city Melbourne with keyword_type=general_only and no suburb grid — the track's own eligibility rule (city in client.delivery_network) has no valid candidates. (2) The freed slots went to quick_wins and category_gap_fill. Final distribution drifted one slot from the 7/5/8 proposed at checkpoint: 'small party catering melbourne' genuinely satisfies quick_wins eligibility (GSC pos 11.55, 1,138 impressions), so it was classified on evidence rather than forced into gap_fill to hit a preset.

eligibility_rules_applied.quick_wins: gsc.position IN [4,15] AND gsc.impressions >= 50 — verified per candidate against the 90d GSC pull
eligibility_rules_applied.existing_page_optimisation: sitemap match — target page exists AND candidate not already in quick_wins
eligibility_rules_applied.category_gap_fill: not in the above AND demand validated by DFS volume or GSC impressions

service_lines: Functions & Event Catering (Private Parties, Weddings, Cocktail/Canape Events)

Weddings is an entire Q10 service line with ZERO tracked keywords, 480/mo, already ranking 7.6. Private celebrations (birthday, baby shower, engagement) are named in Q9 as ideal customers but every existing 'party' keyword in the tracked 50 is corporate-scoped.

Morning & Afternoon Teas is the standout: an explicit Q10 service line with zero tracked keywords and real demand.
